output.location: An empty traditional majlis at night with floor cushions, a brass tray and a carved wooden doorway.
output.look: Warm low-key film look: amber and gold against deep brown shadows, soft grain; the amber bottle always reads against a darker background.
output.lighting: Warm practical lamps from camera-left, deep soft shadows, a thin gold rim on glass and metal.

references.name: brass tray
references.description: A round, flat, hammered brass tray with a low rim.

references.name: coffee cup
references.description: A small white handleless Arabic coffee cup with a thin gold band.

shots.action: A hand sets the coffee cup down on the brass tray; the amber bottle stands in soft focus behind it.
shots.event: a hand sets the cup down
shots.sound: the soft clink of the cup, room tone

shots.action: At the carved doorway the host in a white thobe turns back toward the last guest.
The host lifts the bottle with both hands and offers it; the guest's open palm rises to take it.
shots.event: the host lifts and offers the bottle
shots.sound: strings swell under the oud, a soft glass touch on the palm

shots.action: The bottle stands alone on the brass tray, the gold cap catching the last light.
shots.camera: medium close-up, slow push-in, lower fifth empty
shots.sound: the music resolves on one held note

output.audio: Room tone opens into a single oud line that builds with strings, with a soft glass touch as the bottle meets the guest's palm, and lands on a warm held note on the bottle.
